dialog.quit.title: Quit the launcher?
dialog.cancel.title: Cancel the build?
start_hint: Starts the game. You pick your fighter in the game.
native_lead: Everything OpenRecomp-FGC cannot do yet stays available there: key bindings, problem report, updates.
replays_hint: No saved replays on this PC. Use the section buttons or Back for Games.
replays_lead: Online matches land here by themselves and stay on this PC.
replay_hint: Stored on this PC. The result stays hidden until you show it.
build_running_hint: Build in progress. Steps update here; Confirm asks to cancel.
built_hint: The game is built. You only need to build again after an update.
build_hint: Builds the game from your own files. Nothing leaves this PC.
rebuild_starting: The build is starting, every step again.
rebuild_hint: Redoes every step. Hold to open confirmation; No is the default.
rebuild_lead: Redoes finished steps too. Saves are kept. Hold until the bar fills, then confirm Yes.
no_settings_hint: This game exposes no launcher settings. Use the section buttons or Back for Games.
manifest_screens: OpenRecomp-FGC builds all screens from it.
manifest_hint: A new recomp is just one entry: name, colour, sections, build or exe.
dialog_hint: No is preselected. A stray press changes nothing.
drawer_hint: Friends, lobby, key bindings and problem reports are still in the games' own launchers.
fighter_hint: Used if you do not pick in the game in time.
osk_hint: The D-pad picks the key. A real keyboard works too.
picker_files_hint: Shows only folders and matching files.
hold_hint: Hold with the pad or Enter.
no_native: This game has no launcher of its own.
no_build_here: This game is not built through OpenRecomp-FGC.
folder_hint: Show OpenRecomp-FGC where the game is.
generic_hint: Starts the file the manifest names.
t5.ready_detail: Your game runs locally on this PC. You pick your fighter in the game.
t5.rebuild_detail: This version changes the game code: build once, about 2 minutes.
t5.build_detail: Choose your package and license in the Build section.
display.hint: How the game window opens. F11 and Alt+Enter work in the game too.
display.lead: Borderless fills the screen, a window keeps the PC usable.
resolution.hint: How sharply the game is rendered.
resolution.t5_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Online, each player may use another step.
vsync.hint: Off: least lag, the picture may tear.
vsync.lead: Only changes how the picture reaches the screen.
effects.hint: Hit sparks, flames, smoke, mist, waterfalls.
stage_blur.hint: Soft focus and glow of some stages.
input_delay.hint: Auto picks by ping. Both players set it.
input_delay.lead: More delay means less rollback. In ranked the server sets it.
training.hint: Inputs and frame data in Practice. F2 switches in the game.
training.lead: Shows startup and advantage of every move.
practice.hint: SELECT combos, dummy and recordings in Practice.
always_left.hint: As P2 this PC shows the fight mirrored, you stand on the left.
always_left.lead: Only the picture on this PC changes.
save_replays.hint: Online matches are saved as replays on this PC.
save_replays.lead: A match takes only a few KB.
old_stages.hint: Tekken 5 stages without clearing Arcade. Your save stays as it is.
free_items.hint: All shop items free. Your save is backed up first.
package.hint: Your game package from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
license.hint: Your license file from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
responsive.hint: The build is slower, the PC stays usable.
responsive.lead: The build is slower, but the PC stays usable meanwhile.
t4.ready_detail: Tekken 4 (USA) runs natively on this PC.
resolution.t4_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Auto takes the step of your screen.
fullscreen.hint: F11 or Alt+Enter in the game work too.
sound.hint: The real game sound on the emulated IOP.
sound.lead: Without sound the game runs with a silent stand-in.
aa.hint: FXAA smooths the final picture; SSAA renders a larger scene.
aa.lead: Higher levels may lower fps. SMAA uses FXAA; MSAA uses supersampling.
hud.hint: Sharper HUD, menus and text above native resolution.
hud.lead: Sharp filtering keeps enlarged 2D textures clearer.
anisotropic.lead: Higher levels may lower fps. The default is 4×.
unlock_all.lead: All fighters from the start, without changing your save.
debug.hint: F1 in the game opens the debug window.
iso.hint: Tekken 4 USA as an ISO (SLUS-20328). No BIOS needed.
fighter.lead: After a match is found you pick in the game (30 s, Select = random). The fighter here is used if you do not pick in time.
search.hint: The search runs in the T5DR launcher, OpenRecomp-FGC opens it for you.
ranked.lead: Counts for your rank. The search runs in the T5DR launcher, where you also see the match and ready check.
casual.lead: Unrated, by ping. The search runs in the T5DR launcher.
lobby.hint: The T5DR launcher with lobby, rooms, tournaments, friends and leaderboard.
lobby.lead: Rooms, tournaments, friends, spectating and leaderboard stay in the T5DR launcher.
player_name.hint: Your name for the lobby. The on-screen keyboard is enough.
player_name.lead: How you appear in the lobby.
native_hint: The {name}: controls, problem report and everything not here yet.
game_not_found: OpenRecomp-FGC did not find {name} on this PC.
search_starting: T5DR launcher is starting the search: {name}.
search_opening: T5DR launcher is opening. Start {name} there.
motion_hint: Left/right changes motion. Reduced motion makes changes instant.
dialog.stop.title: Stop this game?
dialog.stop.text: Unsaved progress may be lost. No keeps the game running.
dialog.rebuild.title: Rebuild every step?
dialog.rebuild.text: Finished steps run again. Saves are kept. No keeps the current build.
build_unavailable_hint: Installation not found. Back returns to Games; choose the game folder in Build.
picker_unreadable: Folder unreadable. Confirm opens another folder; Back cancels.
picker_empty: No drives or folders available. Back cancels; reconnect your drive and try again.
picker_no_matches: No matching files here. Confirm opens a folder; Back cancels.
action_failed: Action failed: {error} Check your files in Play or Build and try again.
controls.empty: No pads found. Connect a pad and reopen this section.
controls.hint: Choose a slot and confirm, then press the pad button to bind.
controls.waiting.title: Press a pad button
controls.waiting.text: Release the buttons, then press one button on the selected pad.
controls.waiting.hint: Waiting for a button. Capture ends automatically after a short timeout.
controls.conflict.title: Binding conflict
controls.conflict.text: {source} is already used by {slots}. Move it to this slot?
controls.timeout: No button received. Choose the slot to try again.
controls.multi: More than one button received. Try one button at a time.
controls.disconnected: Pad disconnected. Reconnect it and reopen this section.
controls.failed: Could not bind the button. Reopen this section and try again.
controls.running: Stop the game before changing pad bindings.
controls.unsupported: This install does not provide pad binding support.
support.check.hint: Runs the installed game's checks on this PC. Nothing is sent.
support.report.hint: Creates a report archive on this PC after confirmation.
support.local_only: The report stays on this PC. You decide whether to share it.
support.not_checked: Run the check to look for known problems.
support.no_findings: No known problems found. You can create a local report for further help.
support.report.confirm.title: Create a local report?
support.report.confirm.text: The game's tool collects system details, cleaned logs and settings, and recent replay or desync data into a local ZIP. It stays on this PC; nothing is sent. Create it?
support.failed: The check or report failed: {error} Try again or use the game's launcher.
support.unavailable: This install does not provide problem checking and reporting.
support.finding.package_version.title: The package version is not supported
support.finding.package_version.fix: Choose a supported version of your own game package in Build, then build again.
support.finding.package_damaged.title: The game data may be damaged
support.finding.package_damaged.fix: Check your own package, then rebuild every step in Build. Replace an incomplete package first.
support.finding.unpack_memory.title: Unpacking ran out of memory
support.finding.unpack_memory.fix: Close other programs and try Build again. Use the game's launcher for further memory checks.
support.finding.eu_offline.title: This edition supports offline play only
support.finding.eu_offline.fix: Play offline. Use the game's launcher to check which editions support online play.
support.finding.gpu_tier1.title: The graphics card may limit performance
support.finding.gpu_tier1.fix: Lower the internal resolution and close other graphics programs. See the game's launcher for hardware guidance.
support.finding.two_cores.title: The processor may limit performance
support.finding.two_cores.fix: Close other programs while playing. See the game's launcher for processor requirements.
support.finding.wine.title: Wine or Proton was detected
support.finding.wine.fix: Check the game's launcher for compatibility instructions for Wine or Proton.
support.finding.firewall.title: The firewall may block the game
support.finding.firewall.fix: Review the game's firewall instructions in its launcher. No firewall settings were changed.
support.finding.unknown.title: The game's check found another issue
support.finding.unknown.fix: Open the game's launcher and run its problem check for the exact instructions.
online.name: Player or account name
online.login_hint: Use the same account for all games. Saved logins belong to their lobby server. Logging in here may sign out another launcher.
online.search_hint: Search stops at a match. Ready check and play come in the next part.
online.match_stop: Match found. Ready check and play are not available here yet.
online.keyboard_hint: Use the pad to enter text. Switch pages for lowercase, uppercase and symbols.
online.failure: The lobby action failed. Try again.
online.offline: Log in to search. Guests can play casual matches.
online.kicked: Logged out: this account was logged in from another place. Log in again only when you want to use this launcher.
online.removed: The lobby ended this login. Log in again when you are ready.
online.disconnected: The lobby connection ended. Log in again to continue.
online.matched: Match found. This part stops here; ready checks and playing will come next.
online.match_cancelled: The match ended before play. You can search again.
online.game_running: Close the running game before searching, including games opened by another launcher.
online.process_unknown: Could not check whether the game is running. Search was refused. Try again.
online.build_required: Build a working game before logging in.
online.no_online: This game build does not support online play.
online.client_missing: The installed lobby client is missing or incompatible. Update this game's install.
online.saved_missing: No saved login exists for this lobby. Log in with your account or as a guest.
online.saved_expired: Your saved login expired. Log in with your password.
online.password_required: Enter your account password, or log in as a guest.
online.account_required: Ranked search needs an account. Log out and log in with your account.
online.busy: Please wait for the current lobby request.
online.auth_failed: The login was refused. Check your account name and password.
online.insecure: This server has no secure connection. Use a guest login or configure TLS for this lobby.
online.bad_name: Use a name of 2–16 allowed characters, with no spaces at either end.
online.name_taken: That name is already in use. Choose another name.
online.unavailable: The lobby could not be reached. Check the server and try again.
online.refused: The lobby refused this request. Check your login and try again.
online.server_invalid: The lobby server address or certificate setting is invalid.
online.save_failed: You are logged in, but the saved login could not be updated.
online.logged_out: You are logged out. Your saved login is kept.
online.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
online.version_mismatch: This lobby needs another game build or lobby client. Update this game and try again.
online.server_full: The lobby is full. Try again later.
online.busy_server: The lobby says you are already busy. Stop the other lobby activity and try again.
online.result_hint: Choose your result after both games have ended. T4 results are reported by players.
online.challenge_hint: Challenge this player to a casual match.
online.room_hint: Join this open room for a casual match.
online.chat_hint: Write a message with the keyboard, then send it.
online.start_hint: Start one T4 game for this match. Choose fighters and stage in the game.
online.ranked_unavailable: Ranked is unavailable for T4 until the game can report results.
online.starting: Starting the game for this match…
online.playing: The game is running. Choose fighters and stage in its VS menus.
online.result_prompt: The game ended. Report a win, a loss or no result. These T4 results are reported by players.
online.result_sent: Result sent. You can return to the lobby.
online.t4_matched: Match found. Start when you are ready, or decline.
onboarding.title: Add your first game
onboarding.hint: Install or extract your own recomp, then choose its folder. OpenRecomp does not include games.
onboarding.empty: No games are configured. Add a game manifest to begin.
onboarding.source: Your own install or extracted release
updates.hint: Check this launcher’s release channel. Games and settings stay in place.
updates.confirm.title: Update launcher?
updates.confirm.text:
Install {version} ({size} bytes) and restart? Your settings are kept.

{notes}
updates.current: The launcher is up to date.
updates.unconfigured: Updates need the owner’s signing public key and release channel.
updates.failed: The update could not be completed. Nothing was installed.
updates.busy: Close games, builds and online sessions before updating.
t4.install_invalid: Choose a T4 install containing launcher/t4core.py, or its release zip.
t4.zip_invalid: This T4 zip is not safe to extract. Choose the original release zip.
t4.zip_too_large: This T4 zip exceeds the extraction limit.
t4.install_busy: Close T4 before choosing another install.
t4.install_failed: The T4 install could not be added. Check the folder and try again.
starter.failed: OpenRecomp could not start its private Python. Extract the complete launcher zip again.
updates.rolled_back: The update did not start correctly. The previous launcher was restored.
updates.recovery: The update could not restore all launcher files. Keep the update backup and reinstall the launcher. Your separate game installs and settings are kept.
